subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core land `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or should this remain host/plugin-owned until the Scout/Lobster pilot and RFC settle the artifact contract?
rationale: The implementation is a new sensitive backup/export surface for OpenClaw-owned SQLite state, and the PR body explicitly says the pilot should decide whether the long-term surface is core, host-owned, or both.

options.title: Pause for pilot/RFC
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge the core command until the Scout/Lobster evidence and RFC decide whether core should own the surface.

options.title: Land core MVP after cleanup
options.body: Accept the core `backup sqlite snapshot` contract after removing the lockfile/stale-policy blockers and documenting the security expectations as release context.

options.title: Move to host/plugin path
options.body: Close or replace the core PR if maintainers decide the current plugin/host-owned snapshot path is the right owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Pause for pilot/RFC
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge the core command until the Scout/Lobster evidence and RFC decide whether core should own the surface.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is assigned and already reviewed the snapshot artifact contract in this PR thread.
